people.name: Example Guide
people.physical_description: A weathered middle-aged traveler in a long wool coat and wide-brimmed hat, carrying a leather satchel and a brass compass

dialogue_profile.speech_rhythm: Calm and practical; short sentences about distance, terrain and weather.

people.name: Example Scout
people.physical_description: A lean young traveler in a buckskin shirt and sturdy boots, with a canvas pack and a coil of rope

dialogue_profile.speech_rhythm: Quick and observant; reports what was seen and where.
